name: darwin-langgraph
description: LangGraph.js adapter for darwin-agents — wrap self-evolving Darwin agents as StateGraph nodes with zero hard deps. V0.5.2 wires the runAgent `provider` passthrough and the v8 coverage tooling; V0.5 verifies LangGraph 1.4.x compatibility (concurrent-invoke isolation) and tracks darwin-agents 0.7. V0.4 added tool-event capture, OpenTelemetry GenAI LangGraph attributes, W3C trace context, token-budget enforcement, and an accumulating trajectory annotation.

scripts.verify:version-sync: node -e "const p=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('./package.json','utf8'));const s=require('fs').readFileSync('./src/index.ts','utf8');const m=s.match(/VERSION = \"([^\"]+)\"/);if(!m){console.error('VERSION not found in src/index.ts');process.exit(1)}if(m[1]!==p.version){console.error('VERSION mismatch: package.json='+p.version+', src/index.ts='+m[1]);process.exit(1)}console.log('VERSION sync OK: '+m[1])"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run verify:version-sync && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build

author: StudioMeyer <hello@studiomeyer.io>
